mapper.select: SELECT S.SRVY_SN AS surveySn, -- 설문 SN S.SRVY_TTL AS title, -- 설문 제목 R.RSPSN_CN AS response -- 응답 JSON (질문 포함) FROM TB_BBS_SURVEY S LEFT JOIN TB_RESPONSE R ON S.SRVY_SN = R.PARENT_SN AND R.USER_SN = #{userSn} AND R.DEL_YN = FALSE WHERE S.SRVY_SN = #{srvySn} AND S.SRVY_DEL_YN = FALSE LIMIT 1

SELECT R.USER_SN AS userSn, U.USER_NM AS userName, R.RSPSN_CN AS response FROM TB_RESPONSE R JOIN TB_USER U ON R.USER_SN = U.USER_SN WHERE R.PARENT_SN = #{srvySn} AND R.DEL_YN = FALSE ORDER BY R.RSPSN_SN ASC
